_note: FAINT SIGNAL: a new board family, his Trello card. Every letter has the SAME card, title and first journal, so the board never says which one he has drawn; what changes is what is at the source. The broadcast is the signal itself, heard on arrival.
⛔ FAMILY RULE: no letter's broadcast may hint at what the source is (card 20261031-080934): the survivor, the loop, the coffee and the bait must all sound like someone who wants to be found.

The source is a placed beacon (outpost beacon01, Overtime's own, on 7 recipes; Satellite_Beacon is ruled out on land). Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.
LETTER c: COMEDY: a supply beacon that has asked for coffee, priority urgent, for years.

FAMILY RULE, REFINED 2026-10-31 on the four verdicts: a broadcast may say what KIND of message it is (c's 'supply request', b's all-clear) but not what the source is; and a repeat player may recognise a letter by its call, which is answered by adding letters, not by blanking calls.

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB92c.md): ship, findings 2-4 taken. Forced pick answered YES: a broadcast may say what kind of message it is, so 'Supply request' stands and the player imagines a hungry crew.
